text: Diwali night. The whole colony is staring at one thing...
Tinku's... Super Bomb!
Don't take tension! Louder than the moon!
We're live! Diwali special!
Quiet! Everyone behind the line!
Is it... over?
Wait, wait! This all began... this morning.
Diwali morning. The colony was sparkling...
...and Tinku was snoring.
Super Bomb! Louder than the moon, yaar! Only today!
Louder than the moon?!
Bhaiya... how loud is the moon, exactly?
...Less than this!
My Super Bomb... my baby.
May I say? No name on that box!
No company, no address! And the van guy ran!
Don't take tension! Tinku is here, na!
Let's go, let's go!
I'm saved! My bomb is saved!
Arey Tinku, that was my auto's sneeze!
I've an idea!
Tonight... the Kids' Safety Squad!
Did you hear? Tinku's got a bomb!
And in ten seconds... the whole colony knew.
Look! Super Bomb! Louder than the moon!
Gupta's crackers are nothing next to this! The whole colony will watch!
Tinku!
Ouch! This aim never misses...
Gunpowder near a diya? Is your brain on holiday?
Enough! Now I'll handle it.
Crackers: away from fire, in a cool place.
I'll light the first sparkler today! I fear nobody!
Last Diwali, who hid in the almirah seeing an anar?
That... I was cleaning the almirah. From inside.
Chappal back. Aim ready.
Silent crackers! No smoke, no noise, no fear!
One hundred a box! Not one rupee less!
Seth ji, how does a silent cracker burn?
So quietly... you won't even know!
Science says... sound goes straight to the brain!
Yes... I can hear it!
There's nothing to eat in this either!
I'm hungry!
Did you hear? Seth is selling empty boxes!
Seth ji!
Bindu... this is pollution-free packaging!
<sigh> Silent crackers... silent customers.
Even crackers get the evil eye, beta!
Nani, what if the lemon bursts?
Then it'll be a sour blast.
Havaldar ji was guarding the colony...
Even the horn gets evil eye!
Just one... only for the inquiry.
Probe will happen!
<sigh> Inquiry ate mithai too.
I fear nobody! Only fire, sparks, and noise.
Then one lemon for you also.
By evening... the kids took charge.
This is the safety line! Nobody crosses it!
May I say? Water bucket, sand bucket, and distance!
Pani-puri? Where is the pani-puri?
Pani-puri?! Where?!
Water bucket, Masterji! And sand!
Sandwich? What's the rate of sandwich?
Always on leave at the crucial moment!
All elders here! Hear the rules!
Only sparklers in hand! No other crackers, ever!
Silk away from diyas! Wear cotton!
Five minutes! Coming!
Stop! Back!
I was just... checking the line.
Night came... and our hero returned in cotton.
I fear nobody! Light it!
Arm straight! Away from face! Bucket close!
S-s-sparks!
Aaaaaah!
Why won't it stop?!
Did you hear? Ramesh is running a marathon!
The sparkler went out two minutes ago.
...Then why didn't anyone tell me?
Papa, sparklers are lit standing, not running!
And burnt wire goes straight in water. Not on your feet.
First sparkler... and first marathon!
New prank! Chocolate bomb!
A bomb... smelling of chocolate?
Boo... boo... BOOM!
Laddu blew up!
Laddu!!
There was chocolate inside! I was hungry!
Did you hear? Laddu... is hungry again!
No joking with crackers, didi! Everyone got scared.
Sorry... reel deleted.
And now... back to where the story stopped.
Long incense stick! Arm straight! Light it and step back!
Lit! Run... I mean, step back!
Wait... it's thinking.
Science says... it has gone to sleep.
Stop! Nobody goes near a dud cracker!
May I say? Wait fifteen minutes, then pour water.
Fifteen minutes? My interest is running!
...Louder than the moon.
We're live... unfortunately.
Tinku...
Probe will happen!
It was the horn! Honestly!
What happened? Is mithai being distributed?
Arey Moti... you also got scared?
Animals' ears are much sharper than ours.
What's a cracker to us is a storm to them.
Shhh... a quiet corner for Moti!
Away from the blasts... one little quiet corner.
My ears are old too. I'm staying here!
Come, Moti. No blasts here.
Poor thing got the evil eye!
Shabaash, my Safety Squad.
And then... the Super Bomb's post-mortem.
There will be an inquiry! ...Layer by layer.
Such a big box... only this much inside?
A cracker without a name can be dangerous too.
Chachu, buy from licensed shops. Not vans.
You're right. Next time I'll ask first.
Take tension... just a little.
Seth ji! Empty boxes?
Fine! Free sweets... for everyone!
Free... even saying it hurts.
Inquiry complete.
Divided equally!
That night the colony had less smoke... and more light.
These diyas burn quietly... all night long.
And they don't need a whistle!
New reel... 'Silent Diwali'! We're live!
Did you hear? Pinky's reel is viral!
See? The whole colony saw! The whole country too!
And your chappal is in the reel too!
Science says... the diya is the safest cracker.
Lakhan was right?! ...Did I hear properly?
No cracker in hand, bucket nearby, kids with elders.
And a quiet corner for animals and elders.
Light in the heart... not a blast in the hand.
Happy Safe Diwali!
